fileErrors.TOO_LARGE: This file is too large to be opened.
fileErrors.TRUNCATED: This file is incomplete. It may have been cut off while being copied.
fileErrors.NOT_A_TASKLACE_FILE: This file is not a Tasklace project.
fileErrors.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This project was saved in a format this version of Tasklace cannot read.
fileErrors.NEWER_FORMAT: This project was saved by a newer version of Tasklace. Update Tasklace to open it.
fileErrors.CORRUPTED: This file is damaged and cannot be opened.
fileErrors.DECOMPRESSION_BOMB: This file is damaged: its content is larger than it claims to be.
fileErrors.DECOMPRESSION_FAILED: This file is damaged and cannot be opened.
fileErrors.INVALID_CONTENT: This file is damaged and cannot be opened.
fileErrors.INVALID_PROJECT: This project contains errors and cannot be opened.
fileErrors.READ_FAILED: This file could not be read. Check that it still exists and that you are allowed to open it.
fileErrors.WRITE_FAILED: The project could not be saved. Check that the folder still exists and that you are allowed to write in it.
fileErrors.TOO_COMPLEX: This file is too complex to be opened safely.
fileErrors.INVALID_ENCODING: This file is not UTF-8 text. Save it again as UTF-8, then import it.
fileErrors.INVALID_IMPORT: This file contains errors and cannot be imported.
fileErrors.NO_PROJECT: There is no open project to save.
fileErrors.TASK_FAILED: Something went wrong with this file. Please try again.

app.name: Tasklace
app.tagline: Plan a project on a Gantt chart, alone or together.

repairs.other: {count} changes were adjusted to keep the project valid.

notices.scheduleFailed: The schedule could not be computed. Check the calendar and the start date of the project.

tasks.label: Task
tasks.indent: Indent: put under the task above
tasks.outdent: Outdent: move out of its summary
tasks.milestone: Turn into a milestone or back into a task

editErrors.NOT_POSSIBLE: This change is not possible here.
editErrors.INVALID_DURATION: Write the duration in hours, such as 14, or in working days, such as 2d.
editErrors.INVALID_DATE: This date could not be read. Write it as your computer shows dates, or as 2026-10-05 14:00.
editErrors.INVALID_PROGRESS: Write the progress as a whole number from 0 to 100.
editErrors.INVALID_PREDECESSORS: Write the predecessors by task number, such as 1.2, 3SS+2h, each task once.
editErrors.UNKNOWN_TASK_NUMBER: There is no task with this number.
editErrors.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: This link would make tasks wait for each other in a loop.
editErrors.SUMMARY_DEPENDENCY: Summary tasks cannot be linked. Link the tasks inside them.
editErrors.SELF_DEPENDENCY: A task cannot be linked to itself.
editErrors.HIERARCHY_TOO_DEEP: Tasks cannot be nested this deeply.
editErrors.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: The project has reached its maximum size.
editErrors.OUT_OF_RANGE: This value is outside the allowed range.
